Name: Real Fall Recolor
Author: hypermorphic
Description:
This recolor aims to make fall look more realistic and the leaf colors more appealing.  The leaves cycle through 3 color changes: week 1, week 2, and weeks 3 & 4.  Grass has 4 changes and gradually becomes more sparse and yellow.  Unnatural plant colors have been removed, except where it might cause confusion for foraging.


[u][b]Fix for v1.6[/b][/u]

The soil now transitions through 4 changes, signs in town are not overwritten with English, and other small enhancements.


[u]Installation[/u]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Copy the "[CP] Real Fall Recolor" folder into your game's Mods folder and relaunch.
[/list]

[u]Notes[/u]

I made this mod mostly for myself.  I was so disappointed with the weird purple hue of the fall season that I stopped playing until I could "fix" it.  I can't say whether it's compatible with any other mods, and I only edited the English language tile sheets.  But you are free to improve or reuse any of this work (see the Permissions).
